text.p: These are the leading stories in the Zambian press on Friday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Frederick Chiluba says the sale of Zambia Consolidated Copper Mines houses to miners will start next week.
- Finance Minister Ronald Penza says the collapse of talks between the government and opposition will not affect the outcome of a Consultative Group meeting on Zambia on July 9.
- Police in Lusaka have smashed a car racket in which motor vehicles were being cleared by a fake Interpol office.
- Opposition parties say they will hold a rally in the Zambian capital on Saturday in defiance of a police ban.
- Namibian President Sam Nujoma arrives in Zambia to officially open the 1997 international trade fair.
